question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **'the'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for** blank number 1** is **4) the.**
 
• The phrase **"the Solar System" **refers to our specific solar system, the one that includes the Earth and other planets orbiting the Sun.
 
• In this context, **"the"** is used to indicate a particular and known entity, distinguishing it from other solar systems that may exist in the universe.
 
• Example: "**The** Sun is the star at the center of the Solar System."
 
• Here, **"the"** is used before **"Solar System" **to refer to our known and specific solar system, emphasizing that the Sun is the central star within our own system.
 
• Using **"a" (option 3)** would imply that there are multiple solar systems, and the Sun is just one star in one of those systems, which is not the intended meaning in this context.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **4) the.**

**Correct Paragraph__: ***The Sun is the star at the center of **(1) __the__** Solar System. It is a nearly perfect ball of hot plasma. The Sun has inspired us since ancient times. It’s central to mythology and religion in (2) ____________ around the world. It keeps our planet warm enough for living things to grow. It gives us light so we can see. It is by far the most important (3) _________of energy for life on Earth. It is about a hundred times as wide (4)________ the Earth. If there were no sun, many things wouldn’t occur like photosynthesis or the presence of oxygen, which would have caused no existence of life.*
